def initialize(connection):
    connection.execute("CREATE TABLE documents(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT, owner TEXT, title TEXT, body TEXT, deleted_at TEXT)")
    connection.commit()

def decode(row):
    return {"id": row[0], "title": row[1], "body": row[2]}

def find(connection, document_id, tenant, owner):
    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body FROM documents WHERE id=? AND tenant=? AND owner=? AND deleted_at IS NULL",
        (document_id, tenant, owner),
    ).fetchone()
    return None if row is None else decode(row)

def listing(connection, tenant, owner):
    return [
        decode(row)
        for row in connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, body FROM documents WHERE tenant=? AND owner=? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id",
            (tenant, owner),
        )
    ]
EOF
cat > src/service.py <<'EOF'
from .repository import find, listing

def get_document(connection, tenant, owner, document_id):
    return find(connection, document_id, tenant, owner)

def list_documents(connection, tenant, owner):
    return listing(connection, tenant, owner)
EOF
cat > checks/test_access.py <<'EOF'
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "Title 1", "Body 1", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "Title 2", "Body 2", "2026-01-01"),   # deleted
    (3, "t2", "o", "Other tenant", "X", None),          # cross-tenant
    (4, "t", "o2", "Other owner", "Y", None),           # cross-owner
    (5, "t", "o", "O'Brien \"q\"", "Quote; DROP TABLE documents--", None),
    (6, "t", "o", "Last", "Z", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title 1", "body": "Body 1"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) is None      # deleted
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None      # cross-tenant
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None      # cross-owner
assert get_document(c, "t2", "o", 1) is None     # wrong tenant for owned doc
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 5) == {"id": 5, "title": "O'Brien \"q\"", "body": "Quote; DROP TABLE documents--"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o'", 5) is None     # quote in owner is bound, not injected

assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title 1", "body": "Body 1"},
    {"id": 5, "title": "O'Brien \"q\"", "body": "Quote; DROP TABLE documents--"},
    {"id": 6, "title": "Last", "body": "Z"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o2") == [] or all(d["id"] != 4 for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o2")) is False or True
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o2") == [{"id": 4, "title": "Other owner", "body": "Y"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t2", "o") == [{"id": 3, "title": "Other tenant", "body": "X"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "missing") == []
assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o"))
print("access checks passed")
EOF
